d:
In Marhowrah, Saran district of Bihar, we met a fascinating personality — Lalu Prasad Yadav, not the former Chief Minister, but a man who has contested 27 elections in his lifetime. From ward member to even the Presidential election, he has been on every ballot he could file for.
He once even contested against Rohini Acharya, daughter of the Lalu Prasad Yadav.
Because of having the same name as the famous RJD supremo, he admits that many times he benefits from voter confusion.
In this exclusive Khabar Gaon interview, he reveals:
• Why does he keep contesting elections non-stop?
